formulas.name: log return
formulas.equation: r_t = ln(P_t / P_{t-1}) on H1 closes; stale closed-market slot r_t = 0 (flagged)
formulas.failure_behavior: stale/closed slot: r=0 with stale flag; missing/NaN input -> INVALID with reason

formulas.name: Parkinson 14H oil volatility
formulas.failure_behavior: insufficient closed bars (<14) -> INVALID with reason; zero ranges contribute 0

formulas.name: raw range skew
formulas.failure_behavior: H==L -> gamma=0; invalid OHLC -> INVALID with reason

formulas.name: volatility acceleration
formulas.failure_behavior: previous sigma==0 -> acceleration=0; non-finite -> 0 with reason

formulas.name: DMD / Koopman phase operator
formulas.equation: A = Y X^+; A Phi = Phi Lambda; eligible: 0.95<|lambda|<1.0, Im(lambda)>0; unit-L2 eigenvectors
formulas.failure_behavior: no eligible mode -> w3=0, K1_VALID=false, reason; singular X -> INVALID

formulas.name: mode participation assignment
formulas.equation: P_W = sum|Phi rows 1-2|; P_EC = sum|Phi rows 3-6|; lambda_W/EC = argmax eligible; same mode -> DeltaPhi=0
formulas.failure_behavior: same mode wins both -> DeltaPhi=0; no eligible mode -> w3=0

formulas.name: circular phase distance
formulas.failure_behavior: non-finite phase -> INVALID; result bounded [0, pi]

formulas.name: Vietoris-Rips path distance
formulas.equation: z-score H1 returns on 720-slot state; D_ij = sqrt(sum_{tau=0..5}(z_i-z_j)^2)

formulas.name: runtime topology classification
formulas.equation: epsilon = 0.45*median(D_ij) + 0.015*sigma_W; VR 2-simplices for 3-cliques, 3-simplices for 4-cliques; PERSISTENT/FRAGILE/NO_HOLE via beta1 at epsilon and 1.15*epsilon

formulas.name: causal OLS expected EC distance
formulas.equation: beta = (X^T X)^-1 X^T y, y = lagged D_EC (t-1..t-20), X = [1, D_WE, D_WC] lagged; current t excluded; singular -> K3_OLS_VALID=false, w2=0, no pseudoinverse
formulas.failure_behavior: singular/unstable (X^T X)^-1 -> K3_OLS_VALID=false, w2=0, reason; NO pseudoinverse

formulas.name: EURCAD directional alpha and sizing
formulas.equation: alpha2 = sign(r_E+r_C)*|D_EC-Dhat_EC|; base2 = 0.30*sign(alpha2)*|alpha2|/0.002; w2 = clip(base2*mult, -0.30, +0.30), mult in {1.8, 0.6, 0.0}
formulas.failure_behavior: K3_OLS_VALID=false -> w2=0; non-finite alpha2 -> w2=0 with reason

formulas.name: six-hour EURCAD realized volatility
formulas.failure_behavior: fewer than six valid returns -> INVALID with reason; ddof=1 enforced

formulas.name: antisymmetric commutator
formulas.equation: alpha_D = (1/20) sum_{k=1..20}(A_{t-k}B_{t-k+1} - B_{t-k}A_{t-k+1}); k=1 uses current A_t,B_t; w_total = clip(sign(alpha_D)*min(|alpha_D|/0.0005,1), -1, 1)
formulas.failure_behavior: insufficient history (N<20) -> alpha_D invalid, w_total=0, reason

formulas.name: cluster state machine and base weights
formulas.equation: neutral |w_total|<0.05; long >= +0.05; short <= -0.05; W_base = [w_tot*w1, w_tot*w2, w_tot*0.5*w3] else zeros

formulas.name: gross leverage cap
formulas.equation: g = sum(abs(W_base)); if g>1: W_cap = W_base/g else W_cap = W_base; cap 1.0x NAV
formulas.failure_behavior: non-finite weights -> target rejected with reason; g>1 -> scale by 1/g

formulas.name: reversal fade
formulas.equation: sign reversal: hour1 67% retained, hour2 exactly flat, hour3 linear ramp to 100%; re-flip restarts fade from current exposure; neutral fades to zero
formulas.failure_behavior: signal flip during fade -> restart from current exposure; neutral -> fade to zero

formulas.name: drawdown overlay
formulas.equation: DD = 1 - NAV/max NAV; zones <0.12 full, 0.12-0.18 linear, 0.18-0.195 reflector -0.50, >=0.195 terminal flatten
formulas.failure_behavior: DD>=0.195 -> flatten, terminal lock (manual/new-generation reset only)

formulas.name: per-leg stop
formulas.equation: (LE_t - LE_{t-6})/NAV_t < -0.02 -> leg target 0, 12-bar execution ban; signal continues; rolling clock not reset by resizing
formulas.failure_behavior: trigger -> leg target 0 + 12-bar execution ban; signal continues
